halves_read: engine half (engine/source, root README and LICENSE). Data-pack half (sprites, scripts, sounds, maps) not in the box; no paired donor found by name in the root listing.
combat_fields: 16 defence fields in defense_fields.def:1-16: block power, block ratio, block threshold, block type, block damage min/max/adjust, damage min/max/adjust, knockdown, pain, factor, death config flags, meta tag, meta data
block ratio exposed to scripts via openborscript/commands.c:79; the engine code that applies the block rule was not located

looks.label: Fixed blend table with tint composition
looks.technique: six named blend functions (screen, multiply, overlay, hardlight, dodge, half) indexed by a number; tint mode combines a tint colour blend with the alpha blend

looks.label: Per-row sine shimmer
looks.technique: each output row shifted by one sine table value; amplitude per sprite, wavelength = 256 / float, phase advances per row
looks.ref: engine/source/gamelib/transform.c:1455, 1479, 1516-1526, 1580. Defect (not run): no zero check on wavelength at transform.c:1517; fix: clamp to at least 1

looks.label: Per-actor draw record
looks.technique: alpha, tint colour, tint mode and water settings exposed as script-readable properties on one draw record

looks.label: Palette records
looks.technique: palettes allocated and loaded as records so one sprite can have recoloured variants (body not read)

looks.label: Named screen filters
looks.technique: output filter set: scanline (and TV scanline), dot-matrix, tv2x, bilinear as selectable output modes

originals.name: Hit-flash tint
originals.idea: A short tint pulse on the struck actor from one tint colour and one blend mode held in one per-actor record.
originals.keep: tint colour and blend mode as one record
originals.change: our own colours with a non-colour cue; pulse length tied to hitstop

originals.name: Heat shimmer and ghost wobble
originals.idea: A per-row sine offset on a sprite for a spectral move or boss aura.
originals.keep: row-based sine offset with amplitude and wavelength as data
originals.change: our frame clock as the time base; amplitude capped for 375-wide readability; off in low-quality mode

originals.name: Retro screen filter
originals.idea: A named list of output filters (scanline, dot-matrix, soft) selected per device.
originals.change: CSS or WebGL overlay, off by default on phones

originals.name: Palette-swap variants
originals.idea: One sprite and many recoloured variants from one palette table.
originals.keep: palette as a loadable table per variant
originals.change: our own hue shifts tied to gear tiers in the catalogue, not new art

originals.name: Defence record per defence type
originals.idea: One record per defence type holding block power, block threshold, block ratio, damage min/max/adjust, knockdown and pain.
originals.keep: one record per defence type, tuned as data
originals.change: our own field names and our own block rule (engine rule not read here)
